```formula
S → "(" B ")" B
B → "(" B ")" B | ε
where
S: the start variable, generating only nonempty balanced strings
B: a variable generating balanced strings, including the empty string
"(", ")": terminal parentheses
ε: the empty string
→: may be rewritten as
|: separates alternatives
```

glossary.json inherently-ambiguous: A context-free language for which every grammar is ambiguous, so no rewriting can fix it. -> A context-free language for which every context-free grammar is ambiguous, so rewriting within that grammar class cannot remove ambiguity.

glossary.json chart-parsing: A family of dynamic-programming parsers (CYK is one) that store partial parses of every substring in a table, or chart, to avoid redoing work. -> A family of dynamic-programming parsers (CYK is one) that store reusable partial parsing results in a table, or chart, to avoid redoing work.

glossary.json stored-program-computer: A computer that keeps its program in the same memory as its data, so programs can be loaded, inspected and generated like data. It realises the universal machine idea. -> A computer that stores program instructions in memory rather than fixing the program solely in wiring. A shared instruction-and-data memory is the von Neumann form; stored-program machines can also use separate memories. Programs represented as data can be loaded, inspected and generated.

glossary.json regular-expression-formal: A pattern built from single characters using union (|), concatenation and the Kleene star (*). Formal regular expressions describe exactly the regular languages. Many practical regex engines add features such as back-references that go beyond this. -> A pattern built from the empty language, the empty string and single symbols using union (|), concatenation and the Kleene star (*). Formal regular expressions describe exactly the regular languages. Many practical regex engines add features such as back-references that go beyond this.

compu-grammar-rules.review: Induction on the wrapping rule gives exactly equal a and b blocks, including epsilon; three wraps plus deletion take four steps.

compu-grammar-definition.review: Finite disjoint terminal/variable alphabets and one-variable production left sides define CFGs; translate each DFA state and transition.

compu-grammar-trees.review: Bounded generator terminates for the displayed grammar, not arbitrary CFGs; arithmetic precedence and unique leftmost derivations checked.

compu-grammar-ambiguity.review: Catalan base at one operand and all binary splits give five trees for four operands; dangling else nearest eligible if; inherent ambiguity quantifies CFGs.

compu-cnf-cyk.review: Controlled start epsilon exception preserves the language; full binary variable skeleton gives one fewer binary production than terminal leaves.

compu-cyk-parsing.review: Actual CYK combines all adjacent spans and rules; fixed grammar cubic bound and stipulated cubic scaling distinguished; PEG ordered choice not CFG ambiguity.

compu-pda-stack.review: Empty initial stack convention, abbreviated bottom-marker push, final-state acceptance with all input consumed, nondeterministic branch existence checked.

compu-pda-simulation.review: Full configurations include input position and stack; finite cap valid only for displayed machines; even palindrome nondeterminism requires a two-symbol alphabet.

compu-pda-equivalence.review: CFG-to-PDA invariant is remaining leftmost derivation; reverse direction labelled sketch; LR/DCFL theorem checked with end marker conventions.

compu-cfl-pumping.review: Quantifier order and both pumped pieces checked; lowest repeated variable on longest CNF path yields bounded window and nonempty pumped pair.

compu-cfl-limits.review: Every legal split of equal-three-block and copy witnesses defeated; weak unary/alternating/copy witnesses admit valid pumping; bounded enumeration corroborates proof.

compu-cfl-closure.review: Union/concatenation/star constructions rename variables apart; intersection counterexample, De Morgan complement failure and regular-product construction checked.

compu-tm-model.review: TM alphabets/states finite, blank excluded from input, accept/reject distinct; recogniser permits divergence only outside accepted language.

compu-tm-increment.review: Binary increment trace, write/move/state tuple order, finite cap validation and carry over left blank checked by native execution.

compu-tm-crossing.review: Order and count crossing-off invariants checked; exact native sample steps and quadratic scan argument; two-tape linear strategy checked.

compu-tm-variants.review: One- and two-way, fixed multitape and nondeterministic variants preserve recognisability; quadratic simulation assumes run at least input length.

compu-busy-beaver.review: Working state convention, blank two-way tape and two symbols match primary BB values; 2024 certified proof and stronger domination theorem distinguished.

compu-effective-models.review: Effective procedure is informal; formal equivalence differs from thesis. Church successor, addition and multiplication native results checked; eager recursion caveat.

compu-universal-machine.review: Universal machine mirrors accept/reject/diverge; finite practical interpreter cap distinct from ideal unbounded universality.

compu-universal-construction.review: Specific tape/head/control/repetition construction suffices; finite Brainfuck tape not universal, exact wrap/jump/input/bounds semantics native-tested.

compu-language-restrictions.review: Universality needs suitable unbounded operations and encodings; Dolan final jump, Rule110 repeating backgrounds, total fragments and EVM gas caveats checked.

compu-thesis-boundaries.review: Closed finite machine requires complete fixed external state; original/physical/extended theses distinct; effective quantum simulation does not establish efficient simulation.

compu-counting-diagonal.review: Finite strings and descriptions countable; languages are infinite membership sequences; diagonal language differs at each indexed string; floor-log indexing checked.

compu-acceptance-undecidable.review: Total acceptance decider yields total complement-on-self-description machine; malformed descriptions reject; both directions contradict H prediction, looping recognisers do not.

compu-halting-undecidable.review: Total halting placeholder has no implementation; true and false oracle branches contradict predictions; rejecting also halts; native bounded harnesses confirm branches.

compu-dovetailing.review: Run recognisers fairly, ignore rejecting or divergent branches; exactly one side eventually accepts; square generators restricted to nonnegative integers.

compu-halting-practice.review: Bounded simulation decides bounded questions only; Goldbach inner prime checks terminate; unbounded search iff false proof separate from bounded native prefix.

compu-mapping-reductions.review: Mapping total on all strings, yes iff yes, direction of hardness and recognisability backwards; malformed maps/complement universe conventions checked.

compu-halting-reductions.review: Emit new machine description without executing source; rejection replaced by divergence, blank-tape wrapper embeds input, preserves both yes and no cases.

compu-language-reductions.review: Nonemptiness recognisable by dovetailing; two comparisons with empty/all machines reduce nonacceptance to equivalence and inequivalence; neither recognisable.

compu-rice-proof.review: Language-semantic and nontrivial hypotheses exact; empty-language/complement case and gating reference recogniser valid; runtime events require separate reductions.

compu-analysis-limits.review: Sound approximate analyses distinguished from exact formal type checking; constant true Java expression independently rejected on Java21/25; Curry/Church SystemF distinction primary checked.
